'''Morsa''' is a Lady from [[Seanchan]]. Her sign is a silver stag's head.

== Appearance ==
She is young, pale and short. She is regal. Her hair is shaven on the sides of her scalp.

== Activities ==
She was in [[Falme]] when [[Rand al'Thor]] first proclaims himself as the [[Dragon Reborn]].
Later on she is with a group of soldiers back in Seanchan, when they find the [[Gateway]] left by Rand and [[Aviendha]]. She is placed into the custody of the [[Seekers for Truth]] by [[Jalindin]].{{ref/book|5|32}}
